messages:
Sam (AE): Quick alert — Prospect Sentinel's POC stream keeps cutting out ~10s in, causing JSON parse errors. They called this an executive-level blocker.

June (solutions): sorry — can you paste client console + whether they use a corporate proxy/gateway?

Sam (AE): Chrome on managed devices, traffic goes through SentinelProxy. Using hosted API model=redwood-stream-small, stream=true. Customer says bypassing the proxy works.

Aria (eng): assigning. Early hypothesis: intermediate proxy closing idle SSE connections or transforming content. Also check token refresh 401 spikes.

Rex (platform): infra shows a proxy-initiated FIN at 2019990034 and a proxied 502 immediately after. Auth service shows two refresh failures at 2019990032 for the client session. No 429s.

June (solutions): client console snippet: 
```
EventSource open
onmessage: data len=178
onmessage: data len=42 -> Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
reconnect in 1.2s
fetch error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
```

Aria (eng): likely proxy idle timeout ~12s + auth refresh race. Short-term ask to SentinelProxy admin: increase idle timeout to >=60s, disable buffering for `Accept: text/event-stream`, preserve `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, and avoid gzip for SSE. If nginx: `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.

Rex (platform): server fast-mitigation: enable SSE comment heartbeats (every 8s), add `retry: 1500`, set `Cache-Control: no-transform`, and a small auth-tolerance window so a transient 401 during token refresh doesn't abort an in-flight stream. I'll queue a canary. ops-bot: schedule canary for sse-heartbeat.

ops-bot: Canary queued: sse-heartbeat=8s on 3 hosts.

June (solutions): customer asked if Dedicated would fix this. Short answer: yes, Dedicated in their VPC would remove SentinelProxy from the path and likely avoid this issue.

Aria (eng): SDK mitigation we can share now: buffer partial chunks and attempt to reassemble on reconnect. Pseudo: 
```
let buf=''; es.onmessage = e => { buf += e.data; try { const o = JSON.parse(buf); handle(o); buf=''; } catch(e) { /* wait for more data */ } };
es.onerror = () => { /* backoff reconnect, keep buf */ };
```

Sam (AE): sending customer note with proxy checklist, SDK snippet, and Dedicated option. They will try bypass test tomorrow and report back.

Rex (platform): will monitor canary. last related incident 2019990098, no repeats since canary queued.

Aria (eng): created ticket INF-1605 for SDK reassembly + INF-1606 for auth-tolerance rollout.

Sam (AE): thanks all — will update after their bypass test. :thumbsup:
